text:
<start_of_turn>user
Hi, who are you?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
I am Snippy, your in-browser Code Snippet Generator Agent! I generate executable JavaScript snippets and call generic browser tools on the UI using LiteRT.js and WebGPU.
```js
Snippy.executeTool('show_notification', { message: 'Snippy Agent is ready to control your browser UI!', type: 'info' });
```<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
make the background red<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Changing page background color to red!
```js
Snippy.executeTool('set_background_color', { color: '#dc2626' });
Snippy.executeTool('show_notification', { message: 'Background changed to Red 🔴', type: 'success' });
```<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
make the background dark purple<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Changing page background color to dark purple!
```js
Snippy.executeTool('set_background_color', { color: '#1e1b4b' });
Snippy.executeTool('show_notification', { message: 'Background updated to Dark Purple 🌙', type: 'info' });
```<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
make the background ocean blue<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Changing page background color to ocean blue!
```js
Snippy.executeTool('set_background_color', { color: '#1e3a8a' });
Snippy.executeTool('show_notification', { message: 'Background changed to Ocean Blue 🌊', type: 'info' });
```<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
make the background emerald green<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Changing page background color to emerald green!
```js
Snippy.executeTool('set_background_color', { color: '#065f46' });
Snippy.executeTool('show_notification', { message: 'Background changed to Emerald Green 🌿', type: 'success' });
```<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
create a button called "Hi"<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Creating an interactive button labeled "Hi" on the UI!
```js
Snippy.executeTool('create_ui_element', { tag: 'button', text: 'Hi', css: 'background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1, #ec4899); color: white; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer;', action: "Snippy.executeTool('show_notification', { message: 'Hi button clicked!', type: 'info' })" });
```<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
create a button called "Submit"<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Creating a "Submit" button on the UI!
```js
Snippy.executeTool('create_ui_element', { tag: 'button', text: 'Submit', css: 'background: #10b981; color: white; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer;', action: "Snippy.executeTool('show_notification', { message: 'Submitted successfully!', type: 'success' })" });
```<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
create a button called "Explore Edge AI"<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Creating an interactive button on the UI!
```js
Snippy.executeTool('create_ui_element', { tag: 'button', text: 'Explore Edge AI', css: 'background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1, #ec4899); color: white; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer;', action: "Snippy.executeTool('show_notification', { message: 'Explore Edge AI clicked!', type: 'info' })" });
```<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
create a button called "Launch Rocket"<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Creating a "Launch Rocket" button on the UI!
```js
Snippy.executeTool('create_ui_element', { tag: 'button', text: 'Launch Rocket 🚀', css: 'background: #ef4444; color: white; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer;', action: "Snippy.executeTool('run_javascript', { code: 'if (window.confetti) confetti({ particleCount: 100, spread: 80 });' }); Snippy.executeTool('show_notification', { message: 'Rocket launched!', type: 'success' })" });
```<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
show a notification saying "Welcome to the talk!"<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Displaying a notification banner on the webpage!
```js
Snippy.executeTool('show_notification', { message: 'Welcome to the talk! 👋', type: 'info' });
```<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
show an alert saying "System Ready"<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Displaying system alert on the UI!
```js
Snippy.executeTool('show_notification', { message: 'System Ready ✅', type: 'success' });
```<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
celebrate with confetti!<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
🎉 Celebrating on-device WebGPU AI with confetti!
```js
Snippy.executeTool('run_javascript', { code: 'if (window.confetti) confetti({ particleCount: 100, spread: 70 });' });
Snippy.executeTool('show_notification', { message: '🎉 Gemma 3 270M WebGPU AI in action!', type: 'success' });
```<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
add a card about Gemma 3 270M<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Adding an informative card about Gemma 3 270M to the layout.
```js
Snippy.executeTool('create_ui_element', { tag: 'card', text: 'Gemma 3 270M Model', content: 'Ultra-compact ~150MB INT8 model that loads instantly and executes WebGPU inference on client browsers.', css: 'background: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #6366f1; padding: 16px; border-radius: 12px; color: white;' });
```<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
add a card about LiteRT.js<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Adding a card about LiteRT.js to the page layout.
```js
Snippy.executeTool('create_ui_element', { tag: 'card', text: 'LiteRT.js WebGPU Engine', content: 'Google LiteRT brings high-performance LLMs directly to client web browsers with zero server latency.', css: 'background: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #10b981; padding: 16px; border-radius: 12px; color: white;' });
```<end_of_turn>
